versions.changelog:
- Initial release of funnel-platform-picker skill.
- Helps users choose the best landing page or sales funnel platform by analyzing real total cost and lock-in for specific cases.
- Compares major options such as ClickFunnels, CartFlows, FunnelKit, systeme.io, GoHighLevel, Shopify apps, custom pages, and self-hosted open-source.
- Requires six user inputs (GMV, funnel/client count, list size, catalog/order source, technical responsibility, exit tolerance) to generate accurate recommendations.
- Provides step-by-step guidance to evaluate platforms based on cost models, licensing, and operational trade-offs.
- Includes clear criteria for when to recommend hosted vs self-hosted options, and transparently outlines trade-offs for each choice.
